entries.title: Crewmates ask for what is on your other computers
entries.body: Every crewmate knows which of your computers runs work and which one its task runs on. When it needs a file or a program on another computer, it asks your first mate, which starts a task there instead of asking you. A task there can hand files to the waiting task, and their content is never shown or written down anywhere. Handed files are removed when the task closes.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: crewmates and your first mate coordinate across computers in their own words.
